partners.diseaseBName: constitutional megaloblastic anemia with severe neurologic disease
partners.mechanism_chain: SLC46A1 (HGNC:15427) —DISRUPTS→ folate transport (GO:0015810); folate transport (GO:0015810) —DECREASES→ folic acid (CHEBI:15583); folic acid (CHEBI:15583) —DECREASES→ one-carbon metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1908676); DHFR (HGNC:2585) —DISRUPTS→ folate interconversion (GO:0006785); folate interconversion (GO:0006785) —DECREASES→ 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (CHEBI:17347); 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (CHEBI:17347) —DECREASES→ one-carbon metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1908676); one-carbon metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1908676) —LEADS_TO→ Megaloblastic anemia (HP:0001881); one-carbon metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1908676) —LEADS_TO→ Severe neurologic disease (HP:0002185). Loss-of-function mutations in SLC46A1 impair folate transport into cells, leading to reduced availability of folic acid and its derivatives for one-carbon metabolism. Concurrently, mutations in DHFR impair the conversion of dihydrofolate to tetrahydrofolate, further compromising one-carbon metabolism. Both pathways converge on the critical process of one-carbon metabolism, which is essential for nucleotide synthesis and methylation reactions. Insufficient one-carbon units lead to megaloblastic anemia due to impaired DNA synthesis and severe neurologic disease due to the impact on neuronal function and myelination.
